title: Datacode module artifact manifest
description: Root manifest.json inside a .dcmodule zip (native plugin bundle). Entry symbols are datacode_module_entry (preferred) or datacode_module; see datacode_abi.

version.description: Semantic version of the packaged artifact.

abi_version.description: Must be compatible with the VM: same major and module.minor <= vm.minor (see datacode_abi::abi_compatible).

library.description: Path to the cdylib/dll/dylib relative to the archive root (forward slashes). Use when the bundle contains a single binary for the intended platform.

targets.description: Optional map from Rust-style target triple (e.g. aarch64-apple-darwin) to relative library path. Overrides library when the key matches the host.
